BiblicalUsage: Ahimoth is named once, in the genealogy of the Levites: 'the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth,' standing in the line of the singers and priests.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no lesson to draw from a single name in a Levite list. The list keeps him because the tribe kept its families, and the families served the house of God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
